# Library Imports

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.align = "center")

library(GEOquery)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(glmmTMB)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(patchwork)
library(UpSetR)
library(tidyr)
library(coin)
library(grid)

source("DownstreamAnalysis.R", local = knitr::knit_global())
```

# Data Loading / Cleaning

```{r}

gse <- getGEOSuppFiles("GSE254444")

exp_data <- read.delim(
  "GSE254444/GSE254444_ccRCC.raw_counts.annotations.txt.gz",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# first row, excluding column 1, has sample info
sample_info <- as.character(exp_data[1, -1])

# second row, excluding column 1, has cell type info
cell_type_info <- as.character(exp_data[2,-1])

# create data frame of just metadata info
metadata <- data.frame(
  sample = sample_info,
  inferred_cell_type = cell_type_info
)

# metadata rows will be the cells (all columns besides 1st)
rownames(metadata) <- colnames(exp_data)[-1]

# remove metadata from original data
exp_data <- exp_data[-c(1,2),]

rownames(exp_data) <- exp_data$GeneID
exp_data$GeneID <- NULL

exp_data[] <- lapply(exp_data, as.numeric)
exp_data <- as.matrix(exp_data)

# create individual dataframes for each sample

sample_list <- unique(metadata$sample)

sample_data <- list()

for (sample in sample_list) {
  cellnames <- row.names(metadata[metadata$sample == sample, ])
  sample_data[[sample]] <- as.matrix(exp_data[, cellnames])
}


```

# Data Analysis

## Initial Exploratory Visualization - All Samples

```{r}

allsamplesobj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = exp_data, project = "AllSamples")

cell_meta <- metadata[colnames(allsamplesobj), ]

allsamplesobj <- AddMetaData(allsamplesobj, metadata = cell_meta)

allsamplesobj <- NormalizeData(
  allsamplesobj,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

allsamplesobj <- FindVariableFeatures(
  allsamplesobj,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)

allsamplesobj <- ScaleData(allsamplesobj, features = VariableFeatures(allsamplesobj))

allsamplesobj <- RunPCA(allsamplesobj)
allsamplesobj <- FindNeighbors(allsamplesobj)
allsamplesobj <- FindClusters(allsamplesobj)

allsamplesobj <- RunUMAP(allsamplesobj, dims = 1:20)

DimPlot(
  allsamplesobj,
  reduction = "pca",
  group.by = "sample"
) +
  labs(title = "PCA Dimensional Reduction Plot Separated by Sample",
       x = "PC 1",
       y = "PC 2") +
  theme_minimal()

p <- DimPlot(
  allsamplesobj,
  reduction = "umap",
  split.by = "sample",
  group.by = "inferred_cell_type",
  dims = c(1, 2),
) +
  labs(title = "UMAP Visualization of PCA/Clustering - Separated",
       x = "UMAP 1",
       y = "UMAP 2") +
  theme_minimal()

p & theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1))

DimPlot(
  allsamplesobj,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "sample",
  dims = c(1, 2),
) +
  labs(title = "Initial UMAP Visualization of PCA/Clustering",
       x = "UMAP 1",
       y = "UMAP 2") +
  theme_minimal()

ElbowPlot(allsamplesobj, ndims = 50) + 
  labs(title = "Elbow Plot - Examining PC Variation",
       x = "Principal Component (PC)") +
  theme_minimal()

names(head(sort(abs(Loadings(allsamplesobj)[,2]), decreasing = TRUE), 20))

gene_means <- list()
gene_vars <- list()

counts <- GetAssayData(
  allsamplesobj,
  layer = "counts",
  assay = "RNA"
)

gene_means <- rowMeans(counts)
gene_vars <- apply(
  counts, 1, var
)

gene_df <- data.frame(gene_means = gene_means, gene_vars = gene_vars)


ggplot(data = gene_df[gene_df$gene_vars < 50000, ], 
       mapping = aes(x = gene_means, y = gene_vars)) +
  geom_point(color = "#364d6c") +
  geom_smooth(color = "#78C091", se = F) +
  labs(title = "Mean-Variance Relationship",
       x = "Mean Expression",
       y = "Variance")

```

## HVGs for Individual Samples

```{r}

seurat_list <- lapply(names(sample_data), function(sample) {
  
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = sample_data[[sample]],
    project = sample
  )
  
  cell_meta <- metadata[colnames(obj), ]
  
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, metadata = cell_meta)
  
  return(obj)
})

names(seurat_list) <- names(sample_data)

top_genes <- list()
top_genes_fromAll <- list()

# Normalize and find 2000 HVGs for each sample

hvg_2000 <- list()

for (sample in names(seurat_list)) {
  
  o <- seurat_list[[sample]]
  
  o <- NormalizeData(
    o,
    normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
    scale.factor = 10000
  )
  
  o <- FindVariableFeatures(
    o, 
    selection.method = "vst",
    nfeatures = 2000
  )
  
  hvg_2000[[sample]] <- VariableFeatures(o)
}

shared_genes <- Reduce(
  intersect,
  hvg_2000
)

upset(fromList(hvg_2000), 
      order.by = c("freq"), 
      nsets = 6, 
      main.bar.color = "#364d6c",
      matrix.color = "#364d6c",
      shade.color = "#bedeff",
      sets.bar.color = "#364d6c",
      queries = list(
        list(query = intersects,
             params = list("L1", "L2", "L4", "L5_1", "L7", "LN"),
             color = "#78C091",
             active = TRUE)
      ))
grid.text("HVG Overlap in Tumor Samples", x = 0.65, y = 0.95,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))

all_var <- VariableFeatures(allsamplesobj)

shared_ranked <- all_var[all_var %in% shared_genes]

top200_shared <- head(shared_ranked, 200)

for (sample in names(seurat_list)) {
  top_genes_fromAll[[sample]] <- shared_genes
}

names(seurat_list) <- sample_list


```

## Downstream Analysis

```{r}

# primary analysis
sameHVGTrial <- downstreamAnalysis(top_genes_fromAll, "SameHVGs")

# Convert Dunn Test results into heatmap

ggplot(sameHVGTrial$dunn_results,
       aes(group1, group2,
           fill = log10(p.adj))) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Pairwise Dunn Test Results",
    fill = "-log10(p)",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Gene expression variability is driven more by inter-tumor heterogeneity 
# than by a simple tumor-versus-normal distinction.

```
